title: Velvety Ukrainian Oats Casserole
description: A rich and savory Ukrainian dish featuring rolled oats, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This low-carb friendly casserole is cooked in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, mushroom broth, dried porcini mushrooms, and salt, stirring until the oats are well coated.
In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the diced onion until softened.
Add the sauteed onion to the oat mixture and stir to combine.
Divide the oat mixture among 4 individual mini cocottes.
Top each cocotte with grated cheddar cheese and a dollop of sour cream.
Cover the cocottes with lids and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the lids and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
